transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Last year I was bouncing around Shanghai a lot, and at one point I even skimmed some course listings just out of curiosity.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Funny thing, my cousin Li Na was the one who actually enrolled in something called "Data Structures and Algorithms"—she kept talking about it for weeks.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Around then, our place needed a cleanup and someone came by on 2025-03-12, mid-afternoon at 15:00, but it was all arranged already.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I remember the address because it sounded so specific: Room 199, Building B, East District. They also called 13891030736 before arriving.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Later that same trip, Liu Yang went to see "The Wandering Earth 3"—he was the one who bought the ticket, not me.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: He kept saying it was at Wanda Cinema Wujiaochang, the 19:00 showtime, and he only got a single ticket since he went solo.

intent.ambiguity_notes: Weak/negative intent: user is reminiscing about past events in 2025 and mentions details as commentary; everything was already enrolled/booked by someone else, with no request for help.
